items.name: Samaritan Pentateuch, MS Nablus 6 (C)
items.shelfmark: Nablus, Samaritan synagogue, MS 6 (C) (with leaves in Oxford, Bodleian Library, Sam c2; Turin, Kahle Library; London, British Library, Or 5036; Princeton University Library, Garrett Collection)
items.dateBasis: colophon (a date written in the manuscript by its copyist: the year 601 of the Hijra)
items.dateSource: Florentin and Tal 2024, Introduction, section 4.1.2.1 (https://doi.org/10.11647/OBP.0415), which quotes the copyist's tashqil in the Song of the Sea
items.format: TEI P5 (the source archive publishes no XML; made from JSON, the edition's Hebrew running text extracted from its PDF by the CACCHT project, by scripts/archives/nablus6.ts). Text the edition takes from other manuscripts for Gen 1:1 to 3:24 is marked <supplied reason="lost"> naming the source; the edition did not mark a few small lacunae it filled from Cambridge Add 714 and the Abisha scroll
